name: Ryan App Builder
tagline: Walks a first-time builder from plain idea to an app on their home screen
description: Describe what you want in plain English and it designs and builds a small working app that pins to your phone's home screen, no code and no app store required. Aimed at people who have never built anything; the sharer's examples were a chore chart and a team schedule. Each step is confirmed before moving on.
author: BlakeKing777
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
